final_candidates.decision_summary: N501Y is the most extensively validated ACE2-binding-enhancing mutation across Alpha and Omicron lineages, creating pi-stacking with ACE2 Y41 and hydrophobic packing contacts.
Q498R forms a salt bridge with ACE2 D38 and is a key affinity-enhancing mutation in Omicron variants with strong structural and epidemiological support.
L452R from the Delta variant enhances ACE2 binding through improved electrostatic complementarity at the receptor-binding interface.

stop_reason.detail: Maximum agent rounds (4) reached; final selection based on strong literature evidence for well-characterized ACE2-binding-enhancing mutations.

history.rationale: N501Y is the most well-characterized ACE2-binding-enhancing mutation, found in Alpha and Omicron variants; creates additional hydrophobic/pi-stacking contacts with ACE2 Y41.
N501Y is the most extensively validated ACE2-binding-enhancing mutation across Alpha, Omicron BA.1/BA.2/BA.4/BA.5 lineages; creates pi-stacking with ACE2 Y41 and hydrophobic packing with K417.
Q498R (Omicron) forms a salt bridge with ACE2 D38 and is a strong independent ACE2 affinity enhancer.
Q498R forms a salt bridge with ACE2 D38 and is a key affinity-enhancing mutation in Omicron; strong structural and epidemiological support.
L452R (Delta variant) enhances ACE2 binding via improved electrostatic complementarity at the interface.
L452R (Delta variant) enhances ACE2 binding through improved electrostatic complementarity and is associated with increased infectivity in multiple studies.
S477N is a recurrent ACE2-binding-enhancing mutation observed in multiple lineages, improving hydrogen-bond network at the interface.
S477N is a recurrent ACE2-binding-enhancing mutation observed across multiple independent lineages, improving hydrogen-bond network at the interface.
N439K enhances ACE2 affinity by forming a salt bridge with ACE2 D30, observed in multiple independent lineages.
N439K forms a salt bridge with ACE2 D30 and has been observed in multiple independent lineages with enhanced ACE2 affinity.
